AD_VAL_RULE.NAME: ETGO Allowed Plan Change Targets
AD_VAL_RULE.DESCRIPTION: The plans the Allowed Plan Changes tab offers from the subscription's plan, or from its pending plan while a change is scheduled; with a change scheduled, also the current plan (keeping it cancels the change)
AD_VAL_RULE.CODE: var sub = String(OB.getParameters().get('inpetgoSubscriptionId')).replace(/'/g, ''); "(exists (select 1 from ETGO_PLAN_CHANGE pc, ETGO_SUBSCRIPTION s where s.id = '" + sub + "'" + " and pc.active = true and pc.targetPlan.id = e.id" + " and pc.plan.id = coalesce(s.pendingPlan.id, s.plan.id))" + " or exists (select 1 from ETGO_SUBSCRIPTION s where s.id = '" + sub + "'" + " and s.pendingPlan is not null and s.plan.id = e.id))"
